en.text: Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

zhSimplified.text: 若不是耶和华建造房屋，

zhTraditional.text: 若不是耶和華建造房屋，

en.text: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

zhSimplified.text: 你们清晨早起，夜晚安歇，

zhTraditional.text: 你們清晨早起，夜晚安歇，

en.text: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

zhSimplified.text: 儿女是耶和华所赐的产业；

zhTraditional.text: 兒女是耶和華所賜的產業；

en.text: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

zhSimplified.text: 箭袋充满的人便为有福；

zhTraditional.text: 箭袋充滿的人便為有福；
